title: Slab on grade at the exterior wall

checklist.item: A vapor retarder is shown directly under the slab, lapped and sealed, and turned up or sealed at the perimeter.
checklist.why: Ground moisture through the slab ruins flooring adhesives.

checklist.item: The top of slab is at least 6 in (150 mm) above adjacent earth, or the wall base is protected where it is lower.
checklist.why: A slab near grade lets surface water reach the wall base.

checklist.item: Perimeter slab insulation is shown where the energy code requires it, with R-value and depth.
checklist.why: The slab edge is the largest thermal bridge at the floor line.

checklist.item: Reinforcing, thickened edge or footing, and the isolation joint against the wall or column are shown and tagged.
checklist.why: The slab cracks where it is restrained without a joint.

checklist.item: The wall's water barrier or flashing laps over the slab edge to the outside.
checklist.why: Water running down the wall must not enter at the slab line.

checklist.item: Joint spacing, sealant and finish are noted, with a scale and material tags.
checklist.why: Missing notes are settled on site.
